crew.overview: In 1970s London amidst the punk rock revolution, a young grifter named Estella is determined to make a name for herself with her designs. She befriends a pair of young thieves who appreciate her appetite for mischief, and together they are able to build a life for themselves on the London streets. One day, Estella’s flair for fashion catches the eye of the Baroness von Hellman, a fashion legend who is devastatingly chic and terrifyingly haute. But their relationship sets in motion a course of events and revelations that will cause Estella to embrace her wicked side and become the raucous, fashionable and revenge-bent Cruella.
crew.title: Cruella

crew.overview: Unlikely hero Mickey Barnes finds himself in the extraordinary circumstance of working for an employer who demands the ultimate commitment to the job… to die, for a living.
crew.title: Mickey 17

crew.overview: England, early 18th century. The close relationship between Queen Anne and Sarah Churchill is threatened by the arrival of Sarah's cousin, Abigail Hill, resulting in a bitter rivalry between the two cousins to be the Queen's favourite.
crew.title: The Favourite

crew.overview: England, 15th century. Hal, a capricious prince who lives among the populace far from court, is forced by circumstances to reluctantly accept the throne and become Henry V.
crew.title: The King

details.biography: Fiona Crombie, an Australian costume and production designer, was born around 1973 in Adelaide. She graduated from NIDA in 1988 and began her career at Sydney Theatre Company. Known for The Favourite (2018), she earned an Oscar nomination for Best Production Design and won BAFTA and ADG awards. Other works include Top of the Lake, Macbeth, Snowtown, Una, Mary Magdalene, The King, and Cruella (2021). She is married with two children.
details.name: Fiona Crombie
